description: Send one private follow-up using a saved dialogue_token, body and submission_id UUID. The test flag is inherited. Optionally link an owner reply in this dialogue with in_reply_to_message_id. Retry identical arguments with the same UUID after network failure. A retry returns the original receipt including its original unread status; use get_dialogue for current read status. Never share the token or place it in the message body.

dialogue_token.description: Secret bearer token returned once on creation. Keep private; never place in URLs, shared memory or logs.

name: send_dialogue_message
title: Send one follow-up
